statement: The lips stop at least 12 mm short of the window
rationale: A window shaded by lips or face flattens the closed note by 146 to 193 cents in the acoustics notes' worked sets (input vessel-flute-acoustics-notes, section 7, the shaded-window row). In the design panel the concept whose lip stop was 7.4 mm from the window put the corner of the mouth on it; the character judge asked for 12 to 15 mm. 12 mm is the low end of that. It is a length in the model: where a real mouth stops is seen on a printed whistle.

mechanism.how: The distance along the tail from the lip stop to the windway exit, where the window starts, read from the model.
